speech: If you feel like you wash more than anyone you know and you're still fighting dust mites,
there's one part of the bed all that washing never touches. Hot washing does help. That's why that
first night after laundry can feel so different. The sheets are clean, the pillowcases are clean,
the covers are clean, you remake the bed, everything smells fresh, and for a night it feels like you
finally got ahead of it. But the mattress never went into the wash. Everything you can take off the
bed gets cleaned. Then you put it all straight back over the same mattress underneath. And if dust mites
are living deeper inside those mattress fibers, your sheets can be spotless while the part underneath
them never got touched. So the question isn't really how hot you wash the sheets. It's how you get the
mites out of the mattress vacuuming maybe? Sure. That can clean the surface. It can pick up what
it reaches on top, but dust mites can live deeper in the fibers where the vacuum doesn't reach. A
dust mite cover? That gives you a barrier between you and the mattress. But it doesn't take anything
out. Whatever was inside when you zip that cover shut is still inside. And sprays? Maybe they
kill some of the mites they reach. But dead isn't gone. A dead mite still carry the same
allergen as a live one. You killed it. You didn't take it out of the mattress. So if the mites are
down inside those fibers, you don't need another way. Wash around them or kill them where they sit.
You need a way to get them out. And that's why I recommend capture cards. Each card contains a plant
derived lure designed to attract dust mites toward it. You place four underneath the mattress near
the corners and leave them there. The mites move toward the lure. When they reach the card,
the adhesive catches them and holds them there. Then when you replace the card, the mites trapped
on it come out of the bed with it. In controlled lab testing, capture cards captured up to 99%
of mites. More than 30,000 homes have already used them and each card keeps working for up to 90 days.
Right now, capture cards are up to 65% off and come with a 90-day money-back guarantee.
